en.headline: Burglars take more than HK$200,000 from Sha Tin flat
en.dek: A 47-year-old woman returned to her Shui Chuen O Estate unit on Sunday night to find a window forced open and cash plus jewellery missing; police are investigating.
body: Police received a report at about 10 p.m. on Sunday that a flat at Ying Chuen House, Shui Chuen O Estate in Sha Tin, had been broken into.

A 47-year-old female resident returned home and discovered that a window had been forced open and the interior showed signs of having been searched. An initial count found that approximately HK$70,000 and RMB 50,000 in cash, together with jewellery and gold items valued at about HK$80,000, were missing.
Officers classified the case as burglary and assigned it to the Sha Tin District Criminal Investigation Team for further inquiries. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邨單位遭爆竊 住戶失逾20萬現金珠寶
zh.dek: 47歲女住戶周日晚返回映泉樓單位，發現窗戶被撬及有搜掠痕跡，約7萬港元、5萬人民幣現金及8萬元珠寶金器失竊，警方列爆竊調查。
body: 警方昨晚約10時接獲報案，指沙田田心水泉澳邨映泉樓一單位懷疑遭人爆竊。
一名47歲女住戶返家後發現單位窗戶被撬開，室內有搜掠痕跡。經初步點算，約7萬元港幣及5萬元人民幣現金，連同共值約8萬元的珠寶及金器不翼而飛。
案件列作爆竊，交由沙田警區刑事調查隊第7隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。
